Definition: desire (and so probably in Proverbs 31:4); hence (by way of alternative) or, also if
BiblicalUsage: 1) or, rather; 1a) implying that the latter choice is preferred; 1b) or if, introducing an example to be seen under a particular principle; 1c) (in series) either...or, whether...or; 1d) if perchance; 1e) except, or else; 2) whether, not the least, if, otherwise, also, and, then
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
